feature_learning: Every full, outer and inner training building subset refits all historical task effects, support gates and transforms from records. Archived full/outer profiles are only old baselines, not new inner features.
domain_weighting: Q,T,difficulty,structure,scope each total 1; all Semi subdomains together total 1. Domains absent for a person-pair are masked and remaining weights normalized, not zero-valued or missing-indicator features.
within_domain_weighting: equal total weight among retained features; absolute Q and task-relative Q share one domain, avoiding independent-evidence double counting

transformation.scale: training-worker IQR, then MAD, then SD if needed
transformation.constant_or_sparse: omit feature if fewer than 6 observed eligible workers or no variance

feature_models.Q: same image/condition/reference task fixed effects, equal-worker zero mean; global beta plus mean/P10/SD and residual-tail/spread descriptions
feature_models.difficulty: existing strength-20 within-person partial-pooling task model, three difficulties separate, contrasts with support gates
feature_models.time: log valid source time, same task and source stratum adjusted separately old audited/new reported; no source-time substitution for target time; source and missingness excluded as class variables
feature_models.structure: training point-pair count and geometric/structure tendency adjusted against common tasks; no target point count or target cluster
feature_models.semi: old confirmed and new reported error non-modification rates/effects separate; actual initialization only for net change descriptions, not an independent Q weight; modified/score increase not confirmed repair
feature_models.scope: same task/condition/source opportunity adjusted answer propensity, no accuracy class from all-in-scope compatible gold
feature_models.direct_errors: retain documentary candidates and audit coverage in explanations; no per-person error rate feature without representative opportunity denominator

conditional_candidate.base: same global full partition at each K
conditional_candidate.split: within each base class, separately for observed easy/medium/hard, split supported workers by sign(theta_d - beta) only if both sides have >=2 workers and mean contrasts differ by >=3 B8 points; otherwise retain one base class
conditional_candidate.unsupported_difficulty: unknown in conditional candidate, not zero effect
conditional_candidate.number_of_classes: at most 2K per observed difficulty; actual singleton/dyad and replacement support always reported
conditional_candidate.test_domain: frozen difficulty is observable; no per-image retyping

selection.target: joint-main-stability Brier, image means then building means, on shared inner heldout replacement events
selection.calibration: k x difficulty within/between rates shrunk toward training baseline by two equivalent buildings; unknown predicted baseline
selection.rule: one standard error, prefer fewer base classes, then global over conditional; all candidate results retained
selection.ablation: all K retained, with comparison at selected main K to separate removed feature information from a changed K
selection.additional_background_panel: A_nested_even_v1 is held out of all type/K/feature selection and used only after type freezing
selection.panel_amendment_status: root frozen before new fusion outputs were available
selection.why: K is primary simplicity axis; fixed global feature-family order is an outcome-independent tie breaker inside one-SE. Every K and family label is retained; no outer scores consulted.

explanation.median_imputation: training-only explanation surrogate; does not affect clustering
explanation.evaluation: report training fidelity separately from pairwise coassignment consistency across training-building perturbations and cross-worker heldout fidelity

prohibited_inputs: heldout replacement geometry/outcomes in type discovery or K selection
worker origin as a class feature
missingness or unaudited events encoded as zero error
verification: heldout-building poisoning leaves training features/classes unchanged
each fit source building list excludes its outer and inner heldout set
pairwise class stability instead of literal class ID comparison
all K and ablation coverage, within-class diameter and bad tail retained
limitation: Retrospective v2 leave-building-out validation after earlier v2 exploration; not a new external blind test. Masked sparse-domain distance may be non-Euclidean and is diagnosed by common-domain coverage. Class usefulness is judged on fresh common events, not intrinsic silhouette alone.
raw_geometry_features: Mean upper and lower equirectangular y normalized by height, only from frozen alternating bound upper/lower points and only training images; no point order change or new scoring.
